notes.title: Update Notes for July 11th
notes.content:
Updated translations for Japanese, Portuguese, Korean, Turkish, Czech, Polish, Hungarian, Russian, & Dutch.
Automated crowdin downloader.
Added dirty flag tracking for FileBasedPrefs.
Fixed NullReferenceException in Legend.Minion.<Update>
Improved FileBasedPrefs to not crash on write access fail.
Fixed prefs file spamming when adjusting volume.

notes.title: Dragon Forge Release Date - July 8th, 2022
notes.content:
[h1]RELEASE DATE[/h1]
We are extremely pleased to announce the release date of [url=https://legendstudio.com/]Legend Studios[/url] newest game, [b]Dragon Forge[/b]!

Dragon Forge will be available through Steam on [b]July 8th, 2022[/b].

Visit our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1163930/Dragon_Forge/]steam page[/url] for more information, screenshots, and gameplay where you can also [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1163930/Dragon_Forge/]Wishlist Now[/url]!

[h2]DRAGON FORGE[/h2]
Become a powerful dragon & automate massive factories! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1163930/Dragon_Forge/]Dragon Forge[/url] is an incremental base building adventure game. Uncurse & explore a huge fantasy world full of quests. Gather resources & craft upgrades to become unstoppable! Discover over 100 fables of ancient wisdom at the Dragon Forge.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1163930/extras/Respawn_Sequence_2_3.gif[/img]

[h2]DEMO[/h2]
A fifteen minute [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1163930/Dragon_Forge/]demo of the game[/url] is available [b]Now through June 20th[/b] where we give you the opportunity to play the game for free and get a sneak peek at what the game has to offer.

We will also be hosting dev streams as part of the Steam Next Fest next week.

[h2]About Legend Studio[/h2]
Founded in 1992, [url=https://legendstudio.com/]Legend Studio[/url] is an independent game developer, creating games such as [url=https://legendstudio.com/dragon-forge/]Dragon Forge[/url], [url=https://legendstudio.com/never-split-the-party/]Never Split the Party[/url], [url=https://legendstudio.com/a-legend-of-luca/]A Legend of Luca VR[/url], and [url=https://legendstudio.com/freecell-quest/]FreeCell Quest[/url].
